answer_1.quote: In text summarization, manual evaluation, as exemplified by the Pyramid method , is the gold-standard in evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: system-generated summaries on the CNNDM dataset

answer_2.quote: However, due to time required and relatively high cost of annotation, the great majority of research papers on summarization use exclusively automatic evaluation metrics, such as ROUGE , JS-2 , S3 , BERTScore , Mover-Score  etc.

answer_4.quote: We collect the system-generated summaries from 25 top-scoring systems... and manually evaluate system-generated summaries of the above-selected test samples.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are presented with a system summary and a set of Semantic Content Units (SCUs) extracted from the reference summary, and asked to mark each SCU as 'present' if it can be inferred from the system summary or 'not present' otherwise.
